entities.name: José Riquelme y López Bago
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Riquelme y López-Bago was a Spanish soldier noted for his involvement in the Second Moroccan War and the Spanish Civil War. He opposed the dictatorship of General Primo de Rivera. In 1987 he was honoured posthumously by King Juan Carlos who restored to him the rank of Lieutenant general.
